sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 57.25% (USD 11.96M cumulative volume) and Lula at 42.50% (USD 12.40M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT. Against the reading confirmed on 26/Sep at 12:00 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 1.10pp and Lula holds still, but the pair sum rose from 98.65 to 99.75, so the normalized move is 0.48pp for each side: more than half of the raw rise is the pair's overpricing. The gap over Lula widens from 13.65pp to 14.75pp, the second widening in a row between confirmed readings, after 22.40pp on 21/Sep, 19.05pp on 22/Sep, 18.35pp on 23/Sep, 12.05pp on 24 and 25/Sep and 13.65pp on 26/Sep.
sentimento.text2: 🥉 OUTSIDE THE WINNER CONTRACT, THE THIRD PLACE BOOK CHANGED LEADER: in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book the lead changed hands between the two confirmed readings: Augusto Cury rises 3.05pp, to 44.40% (USD 0.29M cumulative volume), and Renan Santos falls 4.00pp, to 41.50% (USD 0.43M). Normalized by the book sum, which went from 102.85 to 101.90, the move is 3.37pp up and 3.51pp down, so it is not an effect of the sum. The distance, which had Renan Santos 4.15pp ahead, now has Augusto Cury 2.90pp ahead. In the points recorded in the backup since 22/Sep, Renan Santos's price in that book varied from 4pp to 9.5pp per day and Augusto Cury's from 3.8pp to 12pp. The presidential book received USD 0.36M of new money and totals USD 155.76M cumulative across 19 contracts. ⚠️ Neither of the two presidential contenders is at an extreme: Flávio Bolsonaro's price is 4.45pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep, and Lula's is 8.00pp from his floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr.
sentimento.text3: 🗳️ NO NATIONAL VOTING INTENTION POLL WAS RELEASED FROM 25 TO 27/Sep, and the six from 24/Sep are still the most recent, without agreeing on who leads either round: in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) they run from Lula 40% to 33% at Alfa/TMC to Flávio Bolsonaro 40.4% to 38.4% at Futura, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) from Lula 47% to 45% at Datafolha to Flávio Bolsonaro 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura. What came out were state breakdowns and, in the Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep, with fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep and 2,002 interviews, 47% rate the work of the Supreme Court justices as bad or terrible, 31% as fair and 18% as excellent or good, the highest negative rating in the pollster's series, which began in 2019 (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). 📅 The [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registry sets national releases for Gerp on 27/Sep, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and Nexus on 28/Sep, AtlasIntel, Palver, Vox Brasil and JOTA on 29/Sep, 100 Cidades, Indexa and Ideia on 30/Sep, Datafolha on 01/Oct and DataTrends and Vox Brasil on 02/Oct. A registered release is a commitment by the pollster, not a published number.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 57.25% in the winner contract (USD 11.96M cumulative volume), up 1.10pp raw and 0.48pp normalized, reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT. He is 4.45pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep, and 35.25pp from the floor, 22.00% on 03/Jul. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he stays at 74.50% (USD 1.19M), unchanged raw and down 0.75pp normalized, because the sum of that pair rose from 98.95 to 99.95. ⚖️ His campaign obtained the preliminary injunction suspending the Lula jingle that links Flávio Bolsonaro to the rachadinha and to the Master case, granted by the president of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) (Superior Electoral Court), Kassio Nunes Marques, on 22/Sep, made public on 26/Sep and submitted to the full bench of the court (Estadão and CartaCapital).
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 42.50% in the winner contract (USD 12.40M cumulative volume), unchanged raw and down 0.48pp normalized, reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT. ⚠️ It is not an extreme: he is 25.00pp from the top of the series, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 8.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he rises 1.00pp raw and 0.75pp normalized, to 25.45% (USD 1.04M). 📰 On 26/Sep, at a rally in São Paulo, he linked Flávio Bolsonaro to the Master and [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) cases (Folha de S.Paulo and Brasil 247), and his campaign jingle that makes the same link is suspended by a preliminary injunction from the president of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) (Superior Electoral Court), granted on 22/Sep and made public on 26/Sep.

Normalized by the book sum, which went from 102.85 to 101.90, the move is 3.37pp up and 3.51pp down, so it is not an effect of the sum. sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT (27/Sep, 15:47 UTC), with the presidential book totalling USD 155.76M cumulative across 19 contracts. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move goes the one normalized by the pair sum, or by the whole book when it has more than two relevant names, because the sum of the prices moves on its own. 🗳️ The poll side of the divergence chart uses ONE national poll, not the average: the rule is the most recent one with ties broken by the largest sample, which still gives Palver of 24/Sep, n=5,000, and the choice is declared in the chart itself.

inss.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep EDSON FACHIN GAVE THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE (PGR) FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) AND MASTER CASE INVESTIGATIONS, among them requests to review or revoke detentions, as Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão report. The decision settles none of the requests: after the opinion, the case files go back to him. The investigations have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 ALSO ON 25/Sep, FOLHA DE S.PAULO REPORTS THAT THE DEFENCE OF A FORMER [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) PRESIDENT TURNED TO THE PRESIDENCY OF THE SUPREME COURT against a detention that has lasted more than 300 days; the act has a single source and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ The personal link between the INSS and the Master case recorded on 24/Sep remains the same: the plane Flávio Bolsonaro travelled on in 2025, linked to Daniel Vorcaro and to a lawyer under investigation in the INSS fraud case, and which the senator says belongs to a lawyer friend.
inss.impactoLula: The approval benchmark of this panel is still the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) poll of 21/Sep, registration BR-06004/2026, with 44% approval against 50% disapproval, and from 25 to 27/Sep there was no new national wave from the pollster. ⚠️ APPROVAL WAS MEASURED ON 24/Sep BY DATAFOLHA, ALFA/TMC, FUTURA, PALVER AND PODERDATA, and the spread between them is wider in approval than in disapproval: Datafolha with 47% against 50%, Alfa/TMC with 46% against 50%, Futura/100% Cidades with 44.2% against 53.3%, Palver with 44% against 55% and PoderData/Aya with 41% against 50% on the question about Lula's performance. That is 6 points of distance in approval and 5 in disapproval. Adding Datafolha of 17/Sep, Quaest of 21/Sep and AtlasIntel of 23/Sep, approval measured in eight readings from seven pollsters, between 17 and 24/Sep, runs from 41% to 48%.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep and 44% against 50% on 21/Sep. The 5 point fall stopped and gave 1 back, within the margin. ⭐ And the ASSESSMENT benchmark moved the opposite way in the SAME Quaest wave: the negative rose from 38% to 42%, the positive from 32% to 33% and the fair rating fell from 27% to 23%. These are two different questions and they do not add up. 📌 Datafolha of 24/Sep measures the assessment at 40% negative and 34% positive, and Alfa of the same day adds a third question, which also does not add up with the other two: 55% say Lula does not deserve to be re-elected against 43% who back a new term.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the subject is procedural, not about the merits: the five day window that Edson Fachin opened on 25/Sep for the Office of the Prosecutor-General to give its opinion on the pending requests in the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) and Master case investigations is still running, with none of them decided, and on 26 and 27/Sep there was no new act on the INSS. In the polls there was no new national poll from 25 to 27/Sep, and in the five from 24/Sep that measured approval it runs from 41% at PoderData to 47% at Datafolha.

bancoMaster.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep THE FEDERAL PROSECUTION SERVICE'S SUPERIOR COUNCIL KEPT THE PROSECUTOR-GENERAL, PAULO GONET, ON THE MASTER CASE PROCEEDINGS AND SHELVED THE REQUEST TO INVESTIGATE HIS CONDUCT. Against his removal the vote was 9-0. On the inquiry, which stood at 4-3 in favour of opening it with two votes still to be cast, the result was 5-4 for shelving, and the last vote was cast by the council's vice-president, Nicolao Dino, who was chairing the session because the proceeding involved Gonet himself (G1, Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). The rapporteur, Francisco Sanseverino, pointed out that the messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone do not prove direct contact with the prosecutor-general, and the four defeated council members argued for appointing a deputy prosecutor-general to take the inquiry further, according to G1.
bancoMaster.text2: 📸 ESTADÃO, ON 25/Sep, AND VEJA, ON 26/Sep, REPORT THAT DANIEL VORCARO ATTENDED, ON 31 JANUARY 2024, A LUNCH HOSTED BY GRUPO ESFERA IN HONOUR OF GONET, in Brasília, with about 40 guests, which Gilmar Mendes also attended. VEJA publishes the banker's message from that day: "I'll be at the Esfera lunch with Gonet. Gilmar should be there". Gonet says he had no friendship with Vorcaro, and the banker's defence says it rejects the selective disclosure of private conversations. 📅 The five day deadline that Edson Fachin gave on 25/Sep for the Office of the Prosecutor-General to weigh in on the pending requests in the case is still open, among them those linked to the detentions of Henrique Vorcaro, Felipe Vorcaro, Fabiano Zettel and Daniel Lopes Monteiro.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 comes from the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, and stands at 3.00%, with USD 0.09M cumulative volume, down 0.35pp against the reading confirmed on 26/Sep. AFOS does not attribute the price of that contract to the news flow of the case: it measures both side by side, each with its own timestamp. 🏷️ Still on the calendar, not completed acts, are the testimony of Gabriel Galípolo to the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf), expected in October, and that of Daniel Vorcaro, which was set for 24/Sep and was postponed at the request of the defence, according to Gazeta do Povo.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case moved on 25/Sep through two procedural acts, not decisions on the merits: the Federal Prosecution Service's Superior Council kept Paulo Gonet on the proceedings by 9-0 and shelved by 5-4 the request to investigate his conduct, and Edson Fachin asked the Office of the Prosecutor-General for an opinion within five days on the pending requests. On 26/Sep what arrived was a document about an old fact, the January 2024 lunch, and Gilmar Mendes's public defence of Gonet. The request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided.

stf.toffoli: He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão released on 23/Sep, a survey separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. On 24/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he voted to remove an opponent of Davi Alcolumbre from the Amapá election and that André Mendonça interrupted the ruling; the act has a single source and is recorded here as attributed. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of the inquiry committee request by Alessandro Vieira.
stf.moraes: The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro still has no date, suspended by a request for further review by Flávio Dino. On 22/Sep he was one of the two justices named in the parliamentary inquiry committee (CPI) request that Cristiano Zanin declined to unlock by injunction, and Luiz Fux was drawn as rapporteur of the case on visits by his wife and by Vorcaro to senators. On 25/Sep André Mendonça's filing on the report he used regarding that justice joined the list of pending requests that Edson Fachin sent to the Office of the Prosecutor-General, with a five day deadline. ⚖️ On the same day he was the rapporteur of the criminal case in which the Supreme Court convicted former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, 7-3 in a virtual ruling concluded at night, to one year of detention in an initially open regime for defamation against congresswoman Tabata Amaral (Gazeta do Povo, G1, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo).
stf.gilmar: ⚖️ ON 24/Sep HE TOOK TO THE FULL BENCH OF THE SUPREME COURT a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts (precatórios) with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone showed interest in the vote of one justice in that case (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo). On 25/Sep G1 reports that the AGU (Office of the Attorney General) and he are closing in on the so-called court-ordered debt industry used by Master; the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. On 18/Sep he had publicly admitted a meeting with Vorcaro. 📸 Estadão and VEJA report that he was at the Grupo Esfera lunch in honour of Paulo Gonet, on 31 January 2024, which Vorcaro attended, and on 26/Sep he publicly defended Gonet after the shelving and criticized decisions taken in haste, in reference to André Mendonça, according to O Globo, Valor and Estadão.
stf.dino: On 15/Sep he asked for further review in the ruling on the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the analysis for up to 90 days, and he had not returned the case by 27/Sep; Folha de S.Paulo reports, citing his allies, that the return should come after the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), which is an expectation and not an act. On 22/Sep he said the right moment for the Supreme Court to examine the case on parliamentary earmarks is after the elections, as G1, O Globo and Gazeta do Povo reported.
stf.mendonca: His 76 page filing, submitted on 21/Sep, asks Edson Fachin for the summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority. On 25/Sep it joined the list of pending requests that Fachin sent to the Office of the Prosecutor-General, with a five day deadline. On 24/Sep his office received Flávio Bolsonaro's request to investigate the relationship between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro, and on 25/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he keeps under seal the Master case proceeding in which he denied an operation against Cláudio Castro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution. 🗳️ Also on 25/Sep he ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint of Brazil (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo and CartaCapital), and in the criminal case against Eduardo Bolsonaro he voted for acquittal, defeated along with Luiz Fux and Nunes Marques.
stf.nexo: The link with the election is about the calendar and about institutions, not about the result, and there are two recent measurements of different questions, which do not add up. In the Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep, with fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep, 33% say the conduct of the Supreme Court justices hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy more and 23% say it hurts Lula's more (G1). In the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Bloomberg of 23/Sep, 52.3% say the crisis at the Supreme Court hurts Lula's candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's more. One question is about the conduct of the justices and the other about the crisis, and both pollsters surveyed the same week.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 3.00% (USD 0.09M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, down 0.35pp against the reading confirmed on 26/Sep. It is a thin book, and the price is 23.10pp from the top of the series, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 0.90pp from the floor, 2.10% on 08/Jun. ⚠️ The rating of the Court has a new measurement: in the Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep, with fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep and 2,002 interviews, 47% rate the work of the Supreme Court justices as bad or terrible, 31% as fair and 18% as excellent or good, the highest negative rating in the pollster's series, which began in 2019 (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). ⛔ The panel does not link the price of the contract to the poll or to the acts of the day: it measures both, each with its own timestamp.
stf.fachin: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep HE GAVE THE OFFICE OF THE PROSECUTOR-GENERAL FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE MASTER CASE AND [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) INVESTIGATIONS, which have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep, and only after the opinion will he decide on them (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão). Since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pre-trial detention, undecided as of 27/Sep, and on 24/Sep Flávio Bolsonaro's defence asked him to suspend the investigations that reach the senator, as O Globo reports.
